title: Paystride Payroll-Repaid Loan Servicing Terms for Installments, Direct Payments, Hardship Deferral and Returned Payments
content:
## Servicing terms

(a) Installments of a Paystride Payroll-Repaid Loan are deducted from the borrower's pay each payday under the deduction authorization.

(b) A missed installment is added to the next payday; the number of later paydays it is added to is the product's missed-deduction figure.

(c) Voluntary payments may be made at any time and reduce the balance without penalty.

(d) When employment ends and the product converts the loan to direct pay on separation, or when the borrower revokes the deduction authorization, repayment converts to monthly direct ACH due on the product's direct-pay due day of the month.

(e) A documented hardship may defer up to the tier's number of installments, at most the tier's number of times per loan, counted as the hardship deferral requests approved over the life of the loan.

(f) A returned direct payment is reversed by a payment return and reported only once the loan is past due by the product's credit-reporting figure of days.

## Term (e) by tier

| Tier | Installments a documented hardship may defer |
|---|---|
| Paystride Payroll Loan 500 | 0 |
| Paystride Payroll Loan 1000 | 1 |
| Paystride Payroll Loan 2000 | 1 |
| Paystride Payroll Loan 3000 | 2 |
| Paystride Payroll Loan 4000 | 2 |
| Paystride Payroll Loan 5000 | 3 |

The number of times per loan is counted from the loan's own history: every hardship deferral request approved on that loan since it was made counts once, and the count is compared with the tier's life-of-loan figure.

## Reading the terms

**Collection by payroll deduction.** While repayment is by payroll deduction, each payday carries one installment, taken from the borrower's pay under the authorization the borrower signed.

**Missed installment.** The installment that was not deducted is added to the next payday rather than dropped.

**Voluntary payment.** A payment the borrower chooses to make, at any time, lowers the balance, and no penalty attaches to it.

**Conversion to direct ACH.** Either event converts repayment: the end of employment, where the product provides for conversion on separation, or the borrower's revocation of the deduction authorization. After conversion, payments are monthly direct ACH payments falling due on the set day of the month.

**Returned direct payment.** A direct ACH payment that comes back unpaid is reversed by a payment return, which restores the amount to the balance. It is reported only once the loan has reached the credit-reporting number of days past due.

## Hypothetical cases

| Situation (hypothetical) | Result under these terms |
|---|---|
| Paystride Payroll Loan 3000, documented hardship, no deferral approved before, 2 installments asked to be deferred | Within the tier's figure of 2 installments; the loan's count of approved hardship deferrals stands at 0 before this request |
| Paystride Payroll Loan 500, documented hardship | No installment may be deferred, the tier figure being 0 |
| borrower revokes the payroll deduction authorization while still employed | Repayment converts to monthly direct ACH |
| a voluntary payment of a hypothetical $100.00 | The balance falls by $100.00, with no penalty |
